CONFIRMED VULNERABILITY: Stack-buffer-underflow in dissect_ber_GeneralString.

ROOT CAUSE: Type confusion - tvb_len is declared as int8_t (signed) at line 3177, but user input byte at offset can be 0-255. When input byte >= 128, it becomes negative when stored in int8_t.

VULNERABLE CODE PATH:
1. Line 3188: tvb_len = tvb_get_uint8(tvb, offset) - reads user byte into signed int8_t
2. Line 3189: if
